# Disagreement Log — GTH_086

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 86
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 86 | "dens" | "holes" | "dens" | Fox burrow: *phōleos* — dens vs. holes |
| 2 | 86 | "no place to lay" | "nowhere to lay" | "no place to lay" | Location negation phrasing |
| 3 | 86 | "lay his head and rest" | "lay his head and rest" | "lay his head and find rest" | *anapausis*: rest (static) vs. find rest (dynamic) |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "dens," "no place," and "rest" (static, consistent with *anapausis* as a state rather than a discovery here).
